result.title: Productive State-Space Exploration for Multi-turn RL in LLM Agents
result.summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Large Language Model (LLM) agents in multi-turn, long-horizon environments remains challenging due to inefficient action selection and repetitive behavioral patterns. In particular, agents often become trapped in high-confidence yet unproductive behaviors, repeatedly executing invalid actions or entering action loops that hinder task completion. We observe that these frequently violate environment preconditions, revealing a mismatch between the agent's representation of the internal state and the dynamics of the underlying environment. In addition, repetitive high-confidence actions lead to cyclical behaviors that provide little to no progress towards the goal. We argue that addressing these challenges requires more productive task-aligned exploration to improve the agent's understanding of environment dynamics. Motivated by intrinsic curiosity-driven exploration, we propose a conditional state-space exploration framework that balances task completion with intrinsic information-seeking behavior. Specifically, we introduce an intrinsic reward that penalizes actions whose observation duplicates prior state memory. This provides the benefit of reducing redundant behaviors and encouraging state-space coverage without relying on a general information-theoretic measure. Strong experimental results demonstrate that our approach substantially improves policy learning in multi-turn environments, mitigating invalid actions and repetitive loops.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对多轮长时程 LLM agent 中无效动作与动作循环等低效行为，提出条件状态空间探索框架，用惩罚「观测与历史状态记忆重复」的内在奖励，在任务完成与信息寻求之间做平衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「内部状态表示与环境动态不匹配」的诊断，以及基于状态记忆冗余惩罚的探索信号，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态循环、信息坍缩与轨迹训练监督提供可供核查的方法线索。
